humanRequestReassessment.summary: Part/BOM sources supply many legacy part identifiers; product and variant SKU ownership remains unresolved.
Electrical candidates now exist for seven machine models, but 110/220/230 V and motor/speed conflicts remain.
Six drawings and the pallet workbook provide state-specific measurements; currentness and state mapping still require Technical/Operations approval.
Parts and ordering lists generate family/model candidate edges; catalog-product matching and consequential compatibility require approval.
EM-1 manuals provide a detailed candidate BOM but disagree on wheel count/grits; other machines remain incomplete.
Files GIDs, URLs, duplicates, and source associations are indexed; canonical customer-resource version and rights still need approval.
Instruction files supply assembly and safety candidates for EM-1, LapMaster 12, and SawMaster 18; editorial and legal review remains.
